model.name: VIO Group - Enterprise Architecture
model.documentation: Group-level enterprise architecture of VIO Group, a FICTIONAL multinational tour operator. Maintained by Group Enterprise Architecture. It describes the group view only: source-market systems and many integration details are known to other teams and live in their own sources (C4, Backstage, LeanIX, BPMN).

element.name: Trade Partner Portal
element.documentation: B2B portal for travel agencies. LeanIX still calls it 'Reservation Portal'.

element.name: Customer Notification Service
element.documentation: E-mail, SMS and push notifications to travellers.

element.name: Flight Inventory Connector
element.documentation: Seat availability from the group airline and third-party carriers.

element.name: Reservation Platform
element.documentation: Core reservation system of record for package holidays since 2004.

element.name: Inventory Hub
element.documentation: Hotel allotments and availability across all source markets.

element.name: Booking Orchestrator
element.documentation: Event-driven booking orchestration replacing the Reservation Platform.

element.name: Benelux Reservation System
element.documentation: Reservation system of the Benelux market for coach and charter holidays, taken over with a regional tour operator in 2015.

element.name: Dynamic Packaging Engine
element.documentation: Assembles flight, hotel and transfer components into bookable packages.

element.name: Web Shop
element.documentation: B2C web and app shop for all source markets.

element.name: Data Lakehouse
element.documentation: Group analytics platform fed by booking and customer events.

element.name: Agent Desktop
element.documentation: Retail shop and contact centre booking desktop.

element.name: Retire Reservation Platform
element.documentation: Decommission the Reservation Platform once every consumer uses the Booking Orchestration Service. See ADR-0007.
